description: This file contains unit tests for the LocalizedDateFormatter class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing date formatting and localization features with different languages and formats.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LocalizedDateFormatter's date formatting and localization capabilities.

methods.name: testFormatDate
methods.description: Tests the formatting of dates with localization for various date formats and languages.

methods.name: dataProviderForFormatDate
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing date formatting with different languages and formats.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForSameFormat
methods.description: Tests that the caching mechanism effectively reduces repeated calls when formatting dates with the same format.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForDifferentFormat
methods.description: Checks caching behavior across different date formats to ensure efficiency.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithNonLocalizableFormat
methods.description: Ensures that non-localizable formats do not trigger localization method calls.
